title: 5 Degrees North ignite a firestorm of emotion with new single “Burn”
htmlContent: With their new single, "Burn," 5 Degrees North takes a bold step into a darker and heavier sound, showing how much they've grown as a band. Inspired by the energy of bands like Royal Blood, The Amazons, Lenny Kravitz, and Muse, they combine dynamic guitar riffs, powerful basslines, and strong drumming. "Burn" explores deeper themes like self reflection and personal growth. Each verse builds up tension and leads into a powerful chorus. The guitar work is sharp and edgy, while the rhythm section keeps a lively beat, reflecting the song's emotional journey. Even with the heavy sounds, the song's heartfelt message comes through, allowing moments of vulnerability to shine. https://open.spotify.com/album/4IX4g5Ctfvp6n2n7JnU0vQ?si=UDc1PYN8RQaJJA8ErPOPTQ The overall experience is cleansing and energizing, like confronting your past and finding the courage to move forward. 5 Degrees North shows they are ready to grow and try new things. Their adventure into heavier rock has just begun, and we're all excited to see where it takes them.
